return_method: Unitization at each external cash flow using immediately pre-flow native NAV; end-of-day latest available daily close, original daily FX reference. Day = union KR/US trading date. 252 used only as disclosed volatility scaling.
corporate_claim_caveat: Economic NAV includes gross unpaid distribution claims and undelivered share rights from approved reconstructed actions. They remain nonspendable; no actual payment/delivery/tax exemption claimed.
risk_assessment: Post-trade quantities at retained planning marks; unassessed sessions excluded from compliant counts. C/D policy disabled is not zero risk.

B_followup_diagnostic.research_baseline: B within the fixed four-stock experiment only
B_followup_diagnostic.cost_definition: Already included in original NAV and returns. USD equity costs converted at retained daily FX; not a broker statement conversion.
B_followup_diagnostic.cash_definition: KRW plus USD cash at retained FX divided by economic NAV; excludes unsettled claims and does not remove FX risk.
B_followup_diagnostic.execution_interpretation: The opening proxy is inspected after planning; orders are submitted only inside the +/-2% retained planning-mark interval and filled entirely at that proxy. Zero partial-fill events is not a partial-fill validation. FX precedes the opening corporate-action cancellation check.
B_followup_diagnostic.FX_spread_interpretation: All logged fee/notional ratios round to 0.005 at 8 decimal places. Pre-open conversion is outside the code-defined discounted window.

P1_uncertified_excess.failure_class: repair_joint_maximum_net_return candidate failed original master-problem numerical certification
P1_uncertified_excess.interpretation: No certified candidate and no equity fill; ledger and next session continued. Not a successful risk-repair case.

B_followup_diagnostic.risk_recovery_interval_definition: Difference between cumulative relevant-market session numbers: first observed excess to first subsequent assessed compliant session. Excludes the starting session and includes the recovery session. Counts intervening unassessed sessions; excludes calendar holidays and other-market-only sessions. Neither calendar days nor assessed-only session count.
B_followup_diagnostic.risk_recovery_limitations: Assessed compliance uses post-trade quantities at retained planning marks, not actual close-risk certification or continuous compliance. Unassessed sessions never count as compliant. B-mixed longest US interval includes one unassessed session. No full causal decomposition of pre/post orders versus market movement.
B_followup_diagnostic.risk_policy_interpretation: If strict problem is infeasible, risk_repair minimizes residual terminal slack under inherited budgets and permits residual excess. The 10-session count is outcome monitoring, not a deadline argument to native_plan.
limitations: Current roster is not established historical PIT membership.
Historical source/model publication, corporate entitlement/payment/delivery and actual partial fills remain unverified.
Journal replay consistency is not execution realism or proof of absence of future information.
Fixed KR T+2 / US T+1 historical settlement proxy remains unverified across regime changes.

universe_scope_audit.original_default_candidate_rule: Top 20 forecast candidates per market plus all held or required axes; this is not a four-stock rule in the base allocator.
universe_scope_audit.experiment_override: LocalInputs filters forecasts and features to cfg.assets before candidate selection; cfg.assets also supplies required_assets and the initialization basket. Cash starts have zero holdings but the same four-axis candidate restriction.

provenance.selection: First two US forecast/feature-covered names and first two KR names at inception for a five-US-session integration check; US tradable, KR fixed exposure axes; outcome-blind selection stated in the protocol.

provenance.effect: Same four identifiers define retained forecasts/features and required risk axes before any optimization.

The same cfg.assets list defines the initial basket and all later optimization input. The v2, v3 and executed v4 configurations retain the same four stocks; eligible KR and US assets can trade on their respective sessions.
Preparation report already distinguishes pooled 128-name learning from fixed four-name trading and retains the four-stock basket.

universe_scope_audit.intent_boundary: The small v27 scope restriction is explicitly documented. Retained long-run code/configuration demonstrate reuse of that restriction for initialization and later candidates. These artifacts alone do not establish a separate human decision or approval to limit long-run evaluation to four stocks, nor the exact first edit time.
universe_scope_audit.interpretation: These results compare policies within a fixed four-stock execution universe. They do not validate B as a whole-market default model, selection across all 128 forecast names, or universe expansion.
universe_scope_audit.B_superiority_and_default_selection_deci: Deferred until full-candidate revalidation is complete; preserve observed four-stock metrics as historical audit evidence.

E1_pre_fx_preventability_audit.rule: Only cancellation or order-invalidity information demonstrably available at the original FX timestamp may be used.
E1_pre_fx_preventability_audit.reason: The relevant action becomes visible at the simulated open, after the FX timestamp; actual archive availability is late and no verified historical pre-FX notice/publication time is present.
E1_pre_fx_preventability_audit.limitation: Zero is the number proven preventable from retained contemporaneous evidence, not proof that advance information never existed. A future corporate-action event or late archive timestamp must not be relabeled as known before FX.
